[SWS_DM_00902] NumberOfStoredEntries
⌈
If the function GetNum-
berOfStoredEntries()
from
the
ara::diag::DTCInformation
instance ([SWS_DM_00669]) is called, the DM shall return the number of event memory entries
(DTCs) currently stored in this event memory, where the status of a DTC is pend-
ingDTC = 1 and/or confirmedDTC = 1. An update notification shall be sent to the func-
tion registered via SetNumberOfStoredEntriesNotifier() ([SWS_DM_00670])
whenever the value of NumberOfStoredEntries has changed.
⌋

⌈
If the function ara::diag:-

the number of event memory entries (DTCs) currently stored in this event memory,
where the status of a DTC is "pendingDTC = 1"’ and/or "‘confirmedDTC = 1"’. An update
notification shall be sent to the function registered via ara::diag::DTCInforma-
tion::SetNumberOfStoredEntriesNotifier whenever the value of NumberOf-
StoredEntries has changed.
